This is Lemma 3.2 of the CLAUDE two-thirds preprint, provable from von Neumann's trace inequality applied to the spectral decompositions of P and the positive/negative parts of Q; its scalar shadow at r = b = 1 is the integrality step m² ≥ 2m − 1. Prove the two prerequisite targets first if useful.
